mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that may be exacerbated by lopinavir's hepatic metabolism burden and potential additive effects on renal function and cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and cardiac parameters closely; consider lipid formulations of amphotericin B to reduce nephrotoxicity; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation.
